title: Obsolete Create Product Information with Copilot
summary: The Create Product Information with Copilot app is discontinued. Install and upgrade code unregister its Copilot capability, and the Item Substitution Entry page shows a notification pointing users to modern search. The other code objects are marked obsolete pending in 30.0, and the table extension fields move to Removed in 33.0.
key_points: Upgrade unregisters the Create Product Information capability once per database, guarded by an upgrade tag; install also unregisters it
Removed the OnRegisterCopilotCapability subscriber so the capability is no longer re-registered
New notification codeunit on Item Substitution Entry points users to Use modern search, with a Don't show again option
Code objects are wrapped in CLEAN30 with ObsoleteState Pending and tag 30.0; the table extension fields go from Pending to Removed in 33.0
App removed from the build configuration so it is no longer installed
quote: Copilot item substitution suggestions are no longer available. Select Use modern search in Search on the Items list to find alternative substitutions.
